verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a SaaS monitoring platform, but the evidence pack documents no bulk data export, open-format download, or account-exit feature. Community reports about self-hosting and source availability concern deployment options, not exporting your data, and the CLI probe says nothing about export, so none of it counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
